title: Security guard George frozen and later hospitalized
place_text: Mesa, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah; hospital in Las Vegas

tellings.quote: and he said well when we pulled up and you all jumped out i stood up and was frozen i couldn't move and everything went black

plain: In 2016 a security guard named George on Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for strange reports, is said to have frozen in place on a mesa and later ended up in a hospital in Las Vegas. Brandon Fugal, who runs the ranch and was there that night, says George told him that when the others jumped out of the truck he stood up, "was frozen, I couldn't move, and everything went black." Fugal tells it as one of the ranch's direct harms to people.
